definitions.explanation: The protection and preservation of natural environments, ecosystems, and wildlife.

examples.japanese: {自然保護|しぜんほご}は{大切|たいせつ}だ。
{自然保護|しぜんほご}に{取|と}り{組|く}む{団体|だんたい}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: More organizations are working on nature conservation.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{自然保護|しぜんほご}のための{法律|ほうりつ}を{制定|せいてい}した。
examples.english: The government enacted laws for nature conservation.

notes:
{自然保護|しぜんほご} refers to efforts to protect natural environments and ecosystems.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {自然保護|しぜんほご}に{取|と}り{組|く}む: to work on nature conservation
- {自然保護|しぜんほご}{活動|かつどう}: conservation activities
- {自然保護|しぜんほご}{団体|だんたい}: conservation organization
- {自然保護|しぜんほご}{区|く}/{地域|ちいき}: nature reserve, protected area

RELATED TERMS:
- {環境保護|かんきょうほご}: environmental protection (broader concept)
- {野生動物|やせいどうぶつ}{保護|ほご}: wildlife protection
